result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and a partially visible filter chip appears at the edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with the rest of the name cut off.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width and text wrapping show the full restaurant name.

issues.description: Category filter row shows a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right beyond 'Healthy', suggesting incomplete carousel edge treatment.
issues.suggestion: Add proper end padding or fade so only intentional category chips are shown without a stray partial pill.

issues.description: Promo banner secondary text is dense and long for the green card, risking readability on smaller widths.
issues.suggestion: Shorten copy or allow wrapping with clearer hierarchy so the offer and code remain easy to scan.
